title: Umlindo Wabashonelwe
intro: Usuzohlangana nomphefumulo ovivinywe ukuhlukana okujulile, amehlo awo ayewazi ulimi lwezinyembezi kodwa inhliziyo yawo engazange ilahlekelwe yithemba. Endabeni yokukhohlisa, ukulangazelela, kanye nokuhlangana kabusha ekugcineni, le nceku enhle ka-Allah yaba uphawu lokubekezela kuze kube phakade. Ngubani owakhuthazelela iminyaka yobuhlungu obufihliwe, kodwa wabona futhi wabuyiselwa ngesikhashana nje?
clues: Ngingumprofethi ogama lakhe laba uphawu lokubekezela lapho ngibhekene nokulahlekelwa okukhulu.
Ngabusiswa ngamadodana amaningi, kodwa enye yathathwa kimi ngenxa yomona wabanye.
Uthando lwami ngalowo olahlekile lwalujule kakhulu kangangokuthi amehlo ami aphenduka aba mhlophe ngenxa yosizi, kodwa angikaze ngikhononde ngaphandle kuka-Allah.
Ngathumela amadodana ami emuva ukuyofuna leyo engangiyilahlekile kanye nomfowabo, ngiwanxusa ukuba angalilahli ithemba.
Lapho kufika umphathi wezindaba ezinhle, ihembe lambozwa ebusweni bami, futhi ngokuzumayo umhlaba waphinde wacaca.
Ngaziwa ngokuthi u-Israyeli, futhi emadodaneni ami ayishumi nambili kwavela izizwe eziyishumi nambili zesizwe esikhulu.

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
